extraction_notes: Datasheet identity verified as BAT46X SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER, Rev:1.0, three pages; the supplied MPN is BAT46X and the manufacturer is identified as Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Figures 1 through 3 were digitized from the supplied vector plots without synthesized or interpolated points. Figure 1 contains pulsed typical forward-current curves at Ta=25 degC and Ta=100 degC; Figure 2 contains pulsed typical reverse-current curves at those temperatures; reverse current is represented as positive magnitude. Figure 3 is typical junction capacitance at Ta=25 degC and f=1 MHz. Figure 4 is a power-derating rating curve and is omitted from the compact electrical curve set.
All extracted electrical quantities use SI units: mV to V, mA to A, microA to A, and pF to F. Maximum, typical, and digitized-typical semantics are preserved in source_kind.

The electrical characteristics table publishes maximum forward voltage of 0.25 V at IF=0.1 mA, 0.45 V at IF=10 mA, and 1.0 V at IF=250 mA; maximum reverse current of 0.3 microA at VR=1.5 V and 2.0 microA at VR=75 V; typical CT of 20 pF at VR=0 V and 12 pF at VR=1 V, both at f=1 MHz; and minimum V(BR)=100 V at IR=100 microA.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification. This is a Schottky majority-carrier device, so minority-carrier storage and reverse recovery are not modelled.

Absolute-rating data on p. 1 includes VRRM=100 V, VRMS=70 V, VDC=100 V, IF(AV)=0.15 A, IFSM=0.75 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD=150 mW, Tj=-40 to +125 degC, TSTG=-55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJA=667 degC/W; these are limits and are not treated as breakdown data or fitted curve points.
